upstream.name: sddai/markerPDF
upstream.architecture: Python PDF-to-Markdown extraction pipeline using pdftext, pypdfium2, Surya OCR/layout models, table/equation/image extraction, and Markdown post-processing.

benchmarkDenominator.total: 27 inspected upstream benchmark/test/cleanup artifacts: 1 CI workflow, 1 benchmark runner, 2 benchmark scoring modules, 1 score verifier, 6 benchmark documents, 8 committed reference-like markdown outputs, 7 cleaner modules, and 1 Markdown postprocessor
benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow upstream clone at .upstream-cache/markerpdf plus targeted reads of README.md, .github/workflows/tests.yml, benchmarks/overall.py, marker/benchmark/scoring.py, marker/benchmark/table.py, scripts/verify_benchmark_scores.py, marker/pdf/extract_text.py, marker/postprocessors/markdown.py, marker/cleaners/*.py, and data/examples/*/*.md paths. The mapped surrogate fixture samples the README-linked data/examples/marker/multicolcnn.md and data/examples/nougat/multicolcnn.md committed outputs for the same document.
benchmarkDenominator.ciAssertionSource: scripts/verify_benchmark_scores.py checks multicolcnn.pdf > 0.34 and switch_trans.pdf > 0.40 for marker output.
benchmarkDenominator.runnerBlocker: The upstream CI benchmark downloads benchmark_data from Google Drive and requires Poetry plus heavy Python dependencies including torch, surya-ocr, pdftext, pypdfium2, tabled-pdf, and model downloads. The shallow clone contains no benchmark PDFs or references, so the full runner cannot execute locally under the modest network/CPU constraint.
